description: Search or list the public archive of The Durability Curve: essays on which kinds of work keep their value as AI gets cheaper, the checked claims in each essay's claim ledger, the dated calls printed in The Durability Curve Weekly, the five laws and two derived principles the essays are tested against, and the free tools. With a query, returns ranked matches, each with its kind (essay, claim, call, law or tool), a snippet and a URL (canonical for essay citations); "title_matched" says whether any essay title contains every word of the query. With an empty query, lists newest first, filtered by kind, series or has_ledger, and "total" counts every match. Read a match in full with get_essay, get_claim_ledger or get_weekly_calls. These tools retrieve The Durability Curve's public material. They do not certify that any claim is true.

has_ledger.description: true: only essays that have a claim ledger. false: only essays without one.

kind.description: Only this kind of result: essay, claim, call, law (the framework's laws and principles) or tool (the free tools). A list (empty query) defaults to essays.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25. Default 5.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, e.g. "agent reliability", "memory chip deposits" or a call ID like "W02-5". Leave empty to LIST instead (newest first), with the filters below.

series.description: Only essays (and their claims) in this series, e.g. "The Blueprint". Case does not matter.

sort.description: relevance (default for a query) or newest. A list is always newest first.

name: search
title: Search The Durability Curve
